heading: Restriction on discharge from employment by reason of garnishment

tree.heading: Termination of employment
tree.text: No employer may discharge any employee by reason of the fact that his earnings have been subjected to garnishment for any one indebtedness.

tree.heading: Penalties
tree.text: Whoever willfully violates subsection (a) of this section shall be fined not more than $1,000, or imprisoned not more than one year, or both.
